unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a domain-specific BERT model versus zero-shot LLM/NER models for clinical symptom extraction
On-premises local deployment of NLP models to meet data protection requirements
Postprocessing with confidence-based filtering and negation exclusion

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares NLP/LLM models (fine-tuned BERT vs. zero-shot Mistral/GLiNER) for named entity recognition of symptoms in retrospective German emergency department records, focusing on model accuracy rather than evaluating a deployment safeguard or practice.
